metadata.description: Public API snapshot for MAHOUN Constitutional Kernel

delete_node.signature: (self, label: 'str', node_id: 'str', soft_delete: 'bool' = True, deleted_reason: 'str' = 'governance_delete', source_event_id: 'str' = '') -> 'MutationReceipt'

write_relationship.signature: (self, source_type: 'str', source_id: 'str', relationship_type: 'str', target_type: 'str', target_id: 'str', rel_data: 'Dict[str, Any]', merge: 'bool' = True) -> 'MutationReceipt'

queue_relationship.signature: (self, source_type: 'str', source_id: 'str', relationship_type: 'str', target_type: 'str', target_id: 'str', rel_data: 'Dict[str, Any]', merge: 'bool' = True) -> 'None'

check_duplicate_symbols.signature: (filepath: str, manifest: Dict[str, Any], all_symbols: Dict[str, Dict[str, List[int]]]) -> List[str]

extract_imports_from_ast.signature: (tree: ast.AST, filepath: str) -> Dict[str, List[Tuple[int, str]]]

authorize_change.signature: (manifest: Dict[str, Any], version: str, reason: str, approved_by: str) -> None

validate_authorization.signature: (manifest: Dict[str, Any], reason: str, approved_by: str) -> bool

verify_authorization.signature: (manifest: Dict[str, Any], lock_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool

snapshot_rules.critical_apis: Must not be renamed, removed, or have signature changes without authorization
snapshot_rules.non_critical_apis: Can be modified but changes should be documented
snapshot_rules.enforcement: fail-closed - any API drift detection causes CI failure
